socfpga_spi_ll.h

SPI low-level driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

Macros
SPI_GET_INT_ID

Resolves the system-level hardware interrupt request (IRQ) number assigned to a specific SPI instance by the SoC's Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC).

Constants
DesignWare transfer modes (TMOD)

Values written to the transfer-mode field of CTRLR0.

SPI_TX_RX_MOD

Send and receive at the same time. This is the mode set during init.

SPI_TX_MOD

Transmit only. Incoming receive data is discarded.

SPI_RX_MOD

Receive only. The controller generates the clock.  No transmit data is required.

Hardware tuning and timeouts

FIFO limits, the default bus speed, and the poll limit used by the driver.

SPI_TX_FIFO_THRESHOLD

Transmit FIFO threshold written to TXFTLR during init.

SPI_RX_FIFO_THRESHOLD

Receive FIFO threshold written to RXFTLR during init.

SPI_POLL_TIMEOUT

Number of idle poll loops before a polled transfer gives up.

SPI_DEFAULT_SPEED_HZ

Bus speed, in Hz, programmed during init.

SPI_FIFO_SAFE_TX_GAP

Most bytes a polled transfer may send ahead of the bytes it has read back.

Interrupt masking definitions

Values passed to the interrupt status, enable, and disable calls.

SPI_NO_INTERRUPT

No FIFO interrupt is pending.

SPI_TX_EMPTY_INT

Transmit FIFO empty. Selects that bit in the interrupt mask.

SPI_RX_FULL_INT

Receive FIFO full. Selects that bit in the interrupt mask.

SPI_ALL_INTERRUPTS

Every interrupt mask the driver changes.

Status flags

Status values for the transmit and receive FIFOs.

TX_EMPTY

Transmit FIFO empty flag.

RX_FULL

Receive FIFO full flag.

spi_init
void spi_init(
uint32_t 
instance
)

Performs foundational hardware initialization for the target SPI controller.  This involves interacting with the SoC System Manager to un-gate the peripheral clock and the Reset Manager to transition the IP out of its power-on reset state.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

The zero-indexed hardware instance (e.g., 0 for SPI0).

spi_deinit
void spi_deinit(
uint32_t 
instance
)

Reverses the initialization process, asserting the hardware reset line and gating the peripheral clock to eliminate dynamic power consumption when the SPI block is no longer needed.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

The hardware instance index.

spi_select_chip
void spi_select_chip(
uint32_t 
instance,
uint32_t 
slave
)

Writes to the Slave Enable Register (SER) to assert a specific hardware Chip Select (NSS) line. The DesignWare IP can natively drive multiple slaves depending on hardware configuration.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

The hardware instance index.

slave
uint32_t

The one-based chip-select number to assert (1, 2, 3, etc.).  Passing 0 explicitly clears the SER, de-asserting all lines.

spi_set_config
int32_t spi_set_config(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
freq,
spi_mode_t 
mode
)

Configures the master clock divisor and the bus framing parameters. This safely disables the controller (SPIENR), calculates the necessary Baud Rate Select (BAUDR) register divisor based on the peripheral clock, configures the SCPOL and SCPH bits in CTRLR0, and then re-enables the block.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The computed MMIO base address of the SPI instance.

freq
uint32_t

The target serial clock (SCK) frequency in Hertz.

mode
spi_mode_t

The framing mode (CPOL/CPHA) from spi_mode_t.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if freq is 0; -EIO if CLOCK_SSPI cannot be resolved.

spi_get_config
void spi_get_config(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
*
freq,
spi_mode_t 
*
mode
)

Interrogates the hardware's BAUDR and CTRLR0 registers to extract the currently active clock frequency and framing mode settings.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

freq
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the resolved active frequency in Hertz.

mode
spi_mode_t*

Pointer to store the resolved spi_mode_t.

spi_set_transfermode
void spi_set_transfermode(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
mode
)

Modifies the TMOD (Transfer Mode) field within CTRLR0. This dictates whether the hardware will enforce full-duplex transfers or optimize for transmit-only/ receive-only data paths. The controller must be disabled prior to this call.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

mode
uint32_t

The transfer mode constant (e.g., SPI_TX_RX_MOD).

spi_set_loopback
void spi_set_loopback(
uint32_t 
base_address,
bool 
enable
)

Toggles the Shift Register Loop (SRL) bit in CTRLR0. When enabled, the hardware internally routes the TX serial output directly back into the RX serial input, bypassing the physical external pins. Extremely useful for driver diagnostics.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

enable
bool

true to enable internal loopback; false for normal operation.

spi_enable
void spi_enable(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Writes to the SPI Enable Register (SPIENR) to activate the controller. This commits all configuration changes in CTRLR0/BAUDR and readies the FIFOs for data.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

spi_disable
void spi_disable(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Writes to the SPI Enable Register (SPIENR) to halt the controller. Ongoing transfers will be aborted. This is a mandatory step before modifying primary configuration registers.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

spi_get_freq
uint32_t spi_get_freq(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Extracts the current divisor from the BAUDR register and applies the reverse calculation against the SoC's reference peripheral clock to determine the actual SCK frequency.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

Returns

The physical SCK frequency in Hertz, or 0 if it cannot be resolved.

spi_get_version
uint32_t spi_get_version(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Reads the read-only Component Version Register (SSI_COMP_VERSION) baked into the silicon by Synopsys to identify the exact IP revision of the controller.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

Returns

The raw 32-bit hardware version string/code.

spi_write_fifo
uint16_t spi_write_fifo(
uint32_t 
base_address,
const 
uint8_t 
*
buffer,
uint16_t 
bytes
)

Pushes a contiguous block of data into the Data Register (DR). The hardware automatically shifts this into the TX FIFO. The function checks the TX FIFO Level Register (TXFLR) to avoid overflow and stops when the FIFO is full or the requested bytes are written.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

buffer
const uint8_t*

Pointer to the source data.

bytes
uint16_t

Number of bytes to attempt to write.

Returns

The actual number of bytes successfully accepted by the TX FIFO.

spi_read_fifo
uint16_t spi_read_fifo(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint8_t 
*
buffer,
uint16_t 
bytes
)

Pulls available data out of the Data Register (DR), draining the hardware RX FIFO into software memory. It checks the RX FIFO Level Register (RXFLR) to ensure it does not attempt to read from an empty FIFO.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

buffer
uint8_t*

Pointer to the destination memory.

bytes
uint16_t

Maximum number of bytes to attempt to read.

Returns

The actual number of bytes extracted from the RX FIFO.

spi_transfer_poll
int32_t spi_transfer_poll(
uint32_t 
base_address,
const 
uint8_t 
*
txbuf,
uint8_t 
*
rxbuf,
uint16_t 
nbytes,
uint32_t 
timeout_polls
)

Orchestrates a complete, blocking SPI transfer without relying on hardware interrupts. It utilizes a busy-wait loop, repeatedly calling spi_write_fifo and spi_read_fifo, while polling the Status Register (SR) for completion or a timeout threshold.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

txbuf
const uint8_t*

Pointer to the transmission payload (or dummy bytes).

rxbuf
uint8_t*

Pointer to the destination buffer (or NULL if discarding).

nbytes
uint16_t

The total number of bytes to shift.

timeout_polls
uint32_t

The maximum number of busy-wait iterations before aborting.

Returns

0 on success; -ETIMEDOUT or other negative errno code on failure.

spi_wait_idle
int32_t spi_wait_idle(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
timeout_polls
)

Actively polls the BUSY bit in the hardware Status Register (SR). Returns only when the SPI master is completely idle, meaning the TX FIFO is empty and the final bit has been shifted out over the physical pins.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

timeout_polls
uint32_t

The maximum number of polling iterations before aborting.

Returns

0 if the hardware reached idle; -ETIMEDOUT if it remained busy.

spi_flush_rx_fifo
void spi_flush_rx_fifo(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Forcefully clears the Receive FIFO. It polls the RX FIFO Level Register (RXFLR) and executes dummy reads from the Data Register (DR) until the FIFO is entirely empty.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

spi_get_interrupt_status
uint8_t spi_get_interrupt_status(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Reads the consolidated Interrupt Status Register (ISR) to determine what conditions (e.g., TX Empty, RX Full, Overrun) are currently requesting service from the processor.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the SPI block.

Returns

An 8-bit mask representing the active, unmasked interrupt sources.

uint32_t 
base_address,

)

Sets bits in the Interrupt Mask Register (IMR) to unmask specific hardware events, allowing them to propagate to the SoC's Generic Interrupt Controller.

ir_id

spi_disable_interrupt
void spi_disable_interrupt(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
ir_id
)

Clears bits in the Interrupt Mask Register (IMR) to mask specific hardware events, silencing them from triggering external processor interrupts.

ir_id
